answer: Locks are recorded in pigment, expire in cedar, and marble lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 197 aliases therefore needs 142 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The per-identity price is 114 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
